title: A morphism of geometric points induces a bijection of etale stalks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}k\to S$ and $\bar s':\operatorname{Spec}k'\to S$ be geometric points of $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] ($k,k'$ algebraically closed fields). Let $a:\operatorname{Spec}k\to\operatorname{Spec}k'$ be a morphism of schemes with $\bar s'\circ a=\bar s$ (a *morphism of geometric points* $a:\bar s\to\bar s'$). For a pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u')$ of $\bar s'$ (an object $U\to S$ of the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with a lift $\bar u':\operatorname{Spec}k'\to U$ of $\bar s'$), $(U,\bar u'\circ a)$ is a pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar s$. Then for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] there is exactly one map $a^*:\mathcal F_{\bar s'}\to\mathcal F_{\bar s}$ between the stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] sending the class of $\sigma\in\mathcal F(U)$ at $(U,\bar u')$ to the class of $\sigma$ at $(U,\bar u'\circ a)$, and $a^*$ is bijective; for a sheaf of abelian groups $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] it is an isomorphism of abelian groups. (The functor $(U,\bar u')\mapsto(U,\bar u'\circ a)$ between the categories of pointed etale neighbourhoods is an equivalence.)

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Remark 04FN (remark-map-stalks, line 3416): the canonical map of stalks of a morphism of geometric points, 'since the functor above is clearly an equivalence ... this canonical map is an isomorphism of stalk functors'; used in the paragraph before Definition 04FS (line 3984)
